provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^319 - 1 with a(x) = x^5 + x^85 + x^126 + x^186 + x^188 + x^207 + x^243 + x^270, b(x) = x^69 + x^129 + x^134 + x^162 + x^179 + x^202 + x^207 + x^232 + x^250 + x^254 + x^269 + x^302; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
